## File: facebookresearch_fairseq/examples/mms/lid_rerank/mms-zs/uromanize.py

Prompts

```
['run the uromanize CLI tool to convert text files to Unicode romanization using --txt --lid --dst --model args', 'run convert_sent to romanize a sentence into spaced and unspaced pronunciation lexicon strings', 'run uromanize to convert a list of words into a romanized lexicon dictionary via the uroman Perl script', 'run norm_uroman to normalize text by lowercasing, replacing curly quotes, and stripping non-alphabetic characters', 'run the main batch processing loop to uromanize all lines from a text file paired with language IDs']
```

Usage

```
{'run_uromanize_cli': 'run the uromanize CLI tool to convert text files to Unicode romanization using --txt --lid --dst --model args', 'run_convert_sent': 'run convert_sent to romanize a sentence into spaced and unspaced pronunciation lexicon strings', 'run_uromanize_words': 'run uromanize to convert a list of words into a romanized lexicon dictionary via the uroman Perl script', 'run_norm_uroman': 'run norm_uroman to normalize text by lowercasing, replacing curly quotes, and stripping non-alphabetic characters', 'run_batch_uromanize': 'run the main batch processing loop to uromanize all lines from a text file paired with language IDs'}
```
